tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs and anything carrying shadow-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells for evidence, command output and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and panels. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and unproved marks. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Also the fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps and field hints on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Solid, and above 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: proof
tokens.usage: Verdigris. Means one thing: this was proven by execution, reconciliation or a deterministic check. Text and fills on ground, surface, surface-raised and proof-wash.

tokens.name: on-proof
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a proof fill.

tokens.name: proof-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet background for a proven row or panel. Carries proof and ink text.

tokens.name: gate
tokens.usage: Brass. Means one thing: a human must decide. Fill only; put on-gate on it. For text on a surface use gate-ink.

tokens.name: on-gate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gate fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: gate-ink
tokens.usage: Held-for-you words and icons on ground, surface, surface-raised and gate-wash.

tokens.name: gate-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet background for a held row or panel. Carries gate-ink and ink text.

tokens.name: halt
tokens.usage: Ember. Failure, refusal, breach and the kill switch. Text and fills on ground, surface, surface-raised and halt-wash.

tokens.name: on-halt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a halt fill.

tokens.name: halt-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet background for a failed row or a reconciliation break. Carries halt and ink text.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Rising market figures in Trading, always with an up triangle. On ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Falling market figures in Trading, always with a down triangle. On ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Added-line signs, line numbers and counts in Forge diffs. A change is not a finding, so this is never proof. On surface, surface-raised and added-wash.

tokens.name: added-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an added diff line. Carries ink and added text.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Removed-line signs, line numbers and counts in Forge diffs. A removal is not a failure, so this is never halt. On surface, surface-raised and removed-wash.

tokens.name: removed-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a removed diff line. Carries ink and removed text.

tokens.name: iron
tokens.usage: The trade rail. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: iron-raised
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered trade on the rail.

tokens.name: on-iron
tokens.usage: Text and punches on iron and iron-raised.

tokens.name: on-iron-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive trade names on iron.

styles.name: sign-xl
styles.usage: The name, on covers and first-run screens only.

styles.name: sign-lg
styles.usage: Page titles for a trade, and the halted state.

styles.name: sign-md
styles.usage: Section titles and gate headers. Keep to one per panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This order is over Scout's limit, so it waits for you.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, row leads and the verb in an audit line.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Needs a passkey because it moves money.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Audit lines, table numerals, command output, hashes.

styles.name: punch
styles.usage: Hallmark cells, agent punches and trade monograms. Capitals only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row and tile padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Punches, hallmarks, tags, agent marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Human marks and the daemon dot. Reserved: only people are round.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls in tables and rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch targets, and any button that commits money.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The trade rail.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the first row in each column: TradeSidebar's title, SessionHeader and PanelTabs.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: A trade's secondary sidebar, TradeSidebar.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Forge's workspace panel at its default width.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers only. Everything else is separated by line.
